title: Get 40‑70% Off Gym Memberships in Christchurch with Exercise NZ
meta_desc: Learn how Christchurch residents can slash gym fees by 40‑70% through Exercise NZ’s subsidised scheme. Eligibility, steps, participating gyms and savings explained.
intro: Christchurch’s gym scene is diverse, but costs can add up. Exercise NZ offers a government‑backed subsidy that can cut your membership fee by up to three‑quarters. Here’s how to claim it.

sections.heading: What is the Exercise NZ Subsidised Gym Scheme?
sections.body: The Exercise NZ programme is a national initiative that partners with gyms to provide low‑income New Zealanders with heavily discounted memberships – typically 40 % to 70 % off the standard rate. The aim is to make regular physical activity affordable and improve community health outcomes. The scheme is administered through the Exercise NZ website (exercise.org.nz) and funded by the Ministry of Health.

sections.heading: Who is Eligible?
sections.body: Eligibility is based on income, age or specific circumstances. You may qualify if you are: • A low‑income adult (household income below the median NZ$78,000) • A student receiving a student allowance • A senior aged 65+ on a pension • Unemployed and receiving a benefit • A person with a disability receiving support payments. You’ll need proof of eligibility – such as a recent tax summary, student ID, pension statement or benefit letter.

sections.heading: How to Claim Your Discount – Step by Step
sections.body: The claim process is straightforward and can be completed online:
list: 1. Visit https://exercise.org.nz and create a free account.
2. Select “Subsidised Gym Membership” and fill in the eligibility questionnaire.
3. Upload supporting documents (tax summary, student ID, pension statement, etc.).
4. Wait 2‑5 business days for verification – you’ll receive an email with a unique voucher code.
5. Choose a participating gym from the list, present the voucher (or email) at the reception, and sign up for the discounted plan.

sections.heading: How Much Can You Save?
sections.body: Savings depend on the gym’s standard rate and the discount tier you receive. Example calculations: • City Fitness standard $15 /week – 40 % off = $9 /week (save $6/week, $312/year). • Les Mills standard $30 /week – 70 % off = $9 /week (save $21/week, $1,092/year). • Anytime Fitness standard $20 /week – 50 % off = $10 /week (save $10/week, $520/year). Even the smallest discount adds up over a year, making regular training far more affordable.
